findings.text: Independent Opus review pass_with_notes, 0 blocking: three mutations each turned the selftest red (bind 0.0.0.0 -> loopback assertion fails; serve an empty model -> run-presence/classification/same-projection fail; write during a read -> read-only snapshot fails), reverted to green. Independently confirmed /events returns a real SSE frame and POST/PUT/DELETE return 501.
Coverage note (disclosed): the blocking serve() loop and the live SSE stream are not gate-driven (make_server + /status + / are); serve() is thin glue over the driven make_server.

summary: R4 (WARP-0504, thin local status server) is correct and honest. Independent adversarial review pass_with_notes, 0 blocking; gate GREEN (selftest 840). A stdlib http server serves the R3 read model live (JSON at /status, a self-contained page at /, SSE at /events), binds loopback only, is GET-only and read-only, and serves exactly runstatus.status() with no second projection; three mutations proven to turn the selftest red. status_server mechanical is honest (a real ephemeral-port request drives it in the gate). proof_digest via validate.py.
